remarks: Excellent investment opportunity! Well-maintained 2-unit property located at 1800 Williams Street, Buffalo, NY. Each spacious apartment features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, a large living room, and an eat-in kitchen. Both units are currently tenant occupied, generating $1,000 per month per unit ($2,000/month total), providing immediate cash flow for investors. Recent new roof adds value and peace of mind. The property also offers a full basement, private driveway, and a detached garage for additional storage or parking. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, restaurants, and public transportation. Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or occupy one unit while collecting rental income from the other, this property is a fantastic opportunity.
